diseases.name: Hypoglycaemia
diseases.inv: Immediate capillary glucose, then treat per protocol.

diseases.name: Cardiac arrest / life-threatening arrhythmia
diseases.inv: Check pulse and breathing, start resuscitation per BLS/ACLS protocol, ECG.

diseases.name: Sepsis / septic shock
diseases.inv: Lactate, blood cultures, CBC, creatinine, urine; early senior review and antibiotics per local sepsis protocol.
diseases.tool: qSOFA is a bedside risk screen outside ICU; SOFA/NEWS2 are used per local protocols.

diseases.name: Organophosphate poisoning
diseases.inv: Emergency airway, oxygen and antidote treatment per toxicology protocol; contact poison centre; decontaminate.
diseases.alt: Other pesticide poisoning, carbamate poisoning, sedative overdose

diseases.name: Paracetamol overdose
diseases.inv: Time of ingestion, paracetamol level at the right time, antidote per protocol.

diseases.name: Corrosive ingestion
diseases.inv: Airway assessment, do not induce vomiting, urgent endoscopy/surgical review.

diseases.name: Aluminium phosphide poisoning
diseases.inv: Emergency intensive care and poison centre advice; decontamination, ECG, glucose.

diseases.name: Hydrocarbon (kerosene) aspiration
diseases.inv: Chest X-ray, oxygen saturation, observation; avoid induced vomiting.

diseases.name: Sedative overdose
diseases.inv: Airway and breathing support, glucose, ECG, paracetamol level, poison centre advice.

diseases.name: Severe burn / inhalation injury
diseases.inv: Airway assessment, fluids, burn size assessment (Rule of Nines/Lund-Browder), referral to burns unit.

diseases.name: Minor burn
diseases.inv: Cool the burn, assess depth and size; tetanus status.

diseases.name: Arrhythmia or deep injury after electric shock
diseases.inv: ECG, monitoring, CK, urine myoglobin, deep tissue assessment.

diseases.name: Heat stroke
diseases.inv: Rapid cooling, core temperature, glucose, electrolytes, renal function.

diseases.name: Heat exhaustion
diseases.inv: Cool, rehydrate, monitor; escalate if confusion develops.

diseases.name: Drowning / submersion injury
diseases.inv: Oxygen, observe for delayed respiratory deterioration, chest X-ray.
diseases.alt: Aspiration pneumonitis, hypothermia, cervical spine injury

diseases.name: Airway obstruction (choking)
diseases.inv: Immediate airway manoeuvres per protocol; urgent senior help.

diseases.name: Severe dehydration / hypovolaemic shock
diseases.inv: Urgent IV fluids per protocol, glucose, electrolytes, renal function.
diseases.tool: Use WHO dehydration assessment for children and adults.

diseases.name: Major trauma
diseases.inv: Primary survey (ABCDE) with trauma team, FAST scan, CT per protocol.
diseases.tool: ATLS primary survey structure; follow local trauma protocol.

diseases.name: Intra-abdominal injury
diseases.inv: FAST ultrasound, CT abdomen, serial examination.

diseases.name: Chest injury (pneumothorax / haemothorax / rib fractures)
diseases.inv: Chest X-ray or ultrasound; oxygen; senior review.
diseases.alt: Cardiac contusion, pulmonary contusion, aortic injury

diseases.name: Spinal injury
diseases.inv: Spinal immobilisation, neurological examination, CT/MRI.

diseases.name: Haemorrhagic shock
diseases.inv: Control bleeding, IV access, bloods, cross-match, early senior and surgical help.

diseases.name: Perforated viscus
diseases.inv: Erect chest X-ray or CT, bloods, urgent surgical review.

diseases.name: Acute pancreatitis
diseases.inv: Serum lipase or amylase, CBC, calcium, ultrasound for gallstones.
diseases.alt: Perforation, biliary disease, MI, aortic aneurysm

diseases.name: Gallstone disease / cholecystitis
diseases.inv: Ultrasound abdomen, LFTs, CBC.

diseases.name: Mesenteric ischaemia
diseases.inv: Urgent CT angiography and surgical review; lactate.

flags.text: Reduced consciousness: ABC, check glucose immediately, assess pupils and GCS
Collapse without warning with absent or irregular pulse: start resuscitation
Poisoning or overdose: secure airway, identify agent and time, contact poison centre and senior
Severe burn or inhalation signs: airway first, urgent burns care
Palpitations, chest pain or collapse after shock: needs ECG and monitoring
Hot skin with confusion after heat: possible heat stroke, cool rapidly, emergency
Cannot speak, cough or breathe: complete airway obstruction, act immediately
Underwater episode with cough or breathlessness: observe for delayed lung injury
Severe dehydration with cold hands and fast weak pulse: shock, urgent fluids
Major trauma mechanism: primary survey with trauma team
Heavy bleeding after injury: control bleeding and call for help
Severe allergic reaction: anaphylaxis assessment now, call for senior help
Suicide attempt: treat the medical emergency first, then psychiatric risk assessment, do not leave alone
Sudden knife-like abdominal pain with rigid abdomen: possible perforation, urgent surgery
Large ongoing bleeding: possible haemorrhagic shock, control bleeding, call for help
